def line(r0,c0,r1,c1):
    cells=[]
    dr,dc=r1-r0,c1-c0
    n=max(abs(dr),abs(dc))
    for i in range(n+1):
        r=round(r0+dr*i/n); c=round(c0+dc*i/n)
        if (r,c)!=(r0,c0) and (r,c)!=(r1,c1):
            cells.append((r,c))
    return cells

def bres(r0,c0,r1,c1):
    pts=[]
    dx=abs(c1-c0); dy=abs(r1-r0)
    sx=1 if c0<c1 else -1; sy=1 if r0<r1 else -1
    err=dx-dy
    r,c=r0,c0
    while True:
        pts.append((r,c))
        if (r,c)==(r1,c1): break
        e2=2*err
        if e2>-dy: err-=dy; c+=sx
        if e2<dx: err+=dx; r+=sy
    return pts
exp={ (4,8),(4,9),(4,10),(5,6),(6,5),(7,4),(8,3),(9,2) }
for a,b in [((3,11),(10,1)),((10,1),(3,11))]:
    p=set(bres(*a,*b))-set([a,b])
    print(a,b,sorted(p),p==exp)
